bigIdeas.en: Numbers to 100 represent quantities that can be decomposed into 10s and 1s.
bigIdeas.zh: 100 以内的数表示数量，可以拆成几个十和几个一。

bigIdeas.en: Development of computational fluency in addition and subtraction with numbers to 100 requires an understanding of place value.
bigIdeas.zh: 要把 100 以内的加减法算熟，得先懂数位。

bigIdeas.en: The regular change in increasing patterns can be identified and used to make generalizations.
bigIdeas.zh: 递增规律里固定的变化可以找出来，并用来总结规律。

bigIdeas.en: Objects and shapes have attributes that can be described, measured, and compared.
bigIdeas.zh: 物体和图形有各自的特征，可以描述、测量和比较。

bigIdeas.en: Concrete items can be represented, compared, and interpreted pictorially in graphs.
bigIdeas.zh: 实物可以画成图来表示、比较和解读。

elaborations.en: counting: skip-counting by 2, 5, and 10: using different starting points; increasing and decreasing (forward and backward)
elaborations.zh: 数数：2 个 2 个、5 个 5 个、10 个 10 个地跳着数：从不同的数开始；往大数和往小数（顺着数、倒着数）

elaborations.en: Quantities to 100 can be arranged and recognized: comparing and ordering numbers to 100; benchmarks of 25, 50, and 100; place value: understanding of 10s and 1s; understanding the relationship between digit places and their value, to 99 (e.g., the digit 4 in 49 has the value of 40); decomposing two-digit numbers into 10s and 1s
elaborations.zh: 100 以内的数量可以摆一摆、认一认：比较和排序 100 以内的数；以 25、50、100 为基准点；数位：懂得十位和个位；懂得数位和位值的关系，到 99（如 49 里的 4 表示 40）；把两位数拆成几个十和几个一

elaborations.en: even and odd numbers
elaborations.zh: 偶数和奇数（双数和单数）

items.en: benchmarks of 25, 50, and 100 and personal referents
items.zh: 25、50、100 这些基准点和自己身边的参照物

elaborations.en: seating arrangements at ceremonies/feasts
elaborations.zh: 仪式 / 宴会上的座位安排

items.en: addition and subtraction facts to 20 (introduction of computational strategies)
items.zh: 20 以内加减法口算（开始学计算策略）

elaborations.en: adding and subtracting numbers to 20
elaborations.zh: 20 以内数的加减

elaborations.en: fluency with math strategies for addition and subtraction (e.g., making or bridging 10, decomposing, identifying related doubles, adding on to find the difference)
elaborations.zh: 熟练运用加减法的策略（如凑十或过十、拆数、找相关的双倍、往上加着求差）

elaborations.en: decomposing numbers to 100
elaborations.zh: 拆分 100 以内的数

elaborations.en: estimating sums and differences to 100
elaborations.zh: 估算 100 以内的和与差

elaborations.en: using strategies such as looking for multiples of 10, friendly numbers (e.g., 48 + 37, 37 = 35 + 2, 48 + 2 = 50, 50 + 35 = 85), decomposing into 10s and 1s and recomposing (e.g., 48 + 37, 40 + 30 = 70, 8 +7 = 15, 70 +15 = 85), and compensating (e.g., 48 + 37, 48 +2 = 50, 37 – 2 = 35, 50 + 35 = 80)
adding up to find the difference
elaborations.zh: 往上加着求差

elaborations.en: using an open number line, hundred chart, ten-frames
elaborations.zh: 用空数轴、百数表、十格框

elaborations.en: using addition and subtraction in real-life contexts and problem-based situations
elaborations.zh: 在生活情境和问题里用加减法

elaborations.en: whole-class number talks
elaborations.zh: 全班一起聊数（number talks）

items.zh: 重复的规律和递增的规律

elaborations.en: exploring more complex repeating patterns (e.g., positional patterns, circular patterns)
elaborations.zh: 探究更复杂的重复规律（如位置规律、转圈的规律）

elaborations.en: identifying the core of repeating patterns (e.g., the pattern of the pattern that repeats over and over)
elaborations.zh: 找出重复规律的核心（一遍遍重复的那一组）

elaborations.en: increasing patterns using manipulatives, sounds, actions, and numbers (0 to 100)
elaborations.zh: 用教具、声音、动作和数（0 到 100）表示递增规律

elaborations.en: Métis finger weaving
elaborations.zh: Métis 手指编织

elaborations.en: First Peoples head/armband patterning
elaborations.zh: 原住民头带 / 臂带上的图案规律

elaborations.en: online video and text: Small Number Counts to 100 (mathcatcher.irmacs.sfu.ca/story/small-number-counts-100)
elaborations.zh: 在线视频和文字：Small Number Counts to 100

items.en: change in quantity, using pictorial and symbolic representation
items.zh: 数量的变化（用图和算式表示）

elaborations.en: numerically describing a change in quantity (e.g., for 6 + n = 10, visualize the change in quantity by using ten-frames, hundred charts, etc.)
elaborations.zh: 用数描述数量的变化（如对 6 + n = 10，用十格框、百数表等把数量的变化想出来）

items.en: symbolic representation of equality and inequality
items.zh: 用符号表示相等和不相等

items.en: direct linear measurement, introducing standard metric units
items.zh: 直接量长度：开始用标准公制单位

elaborations.en: centimetres and metres
elaborations.zh: 厘米和米

elaborations.en: estimating length
elaborations.zh: 估计长度

elaborations.en: measuring and recording length, height, and width, using standard units
elaborations.zh: 用标准单位量并记录长度、高度和宽度

items.en: multiple attributes of 2D shapes and 3D objects
items.zh: 平面图形和立体图形的多种特征

elaborations.en: sorting 2D shapes and 3D objects, using two attributes, and explaining the sorting rule
elaborations.zh: 按两个特征给平面图形和立体图形分类，并说出分类规则

elaborations.en: describing, comparing, and constructing 2D shapes, including triangles, squares, rectangles, circles
elaborations.zh: 描述、比较和搭出平面图形，包括三角形、正方形、长方形、圆

elaborations.en: identifying 2D shapes as part of 3D objects
elaborations.zh: 认出立体图形上的平面图形

elaborations.en: using traditional northwest coast First Peoples shapes (ovoids, U, split U, and local art shapes) reflected in the natural environment
elaborations.zh: 西北海岸原住民的传统图形（卵形 ovoid、U 形、分叉 U 形和本地艺术图形），它们来自自然环境

items.en: pictorial representation of concrete graphs, using one-to-one correspondence
items.zh: 把实物统计图画成图（一个对一个）

elaborations.en: collecting data, creating a concrete graph, and representing the graph, using a pictorial representation through grids, stamps, drawings
elaborations.zh: 收集数据，做实物统计图，再用格子、印章、图画把它画成图

elaborations.en: one-to-one correspondence
elaborations.zh: 一一对应

items.en: likelihood of familiar life events, using comparative language
items.zh: 生活里的事有多可能发生（用比较的说法）

elaborations.en: using comparative language (e.g., certain, uncertain; more, less, or equally likely)
elaborations.zh: 用比较的说法（如 一定、不一定；更可能、更不可能、同样可能）

items.en: financial literacy — coin combinations to 100 cents, and spending and saving
items.zh: 认识钱：硬币凑到 100 分，花钱和存钱

elaborations.en: counting simple mixed combinations of coins to 100 cents
elaborations.zh: 数简单的几种硬币混在一起，合计到 100 分

elaborations.en: introduction to the concepts of spending and saving, integrating the concepts of wants and needs
elaborations.zh: 初步认识花钱和存钱，并结合「想要」和「需要」

elaborations.en: role-playing financial transactions (e.g., using bills and coins)
elaborations.zh: 角色扮演买卖（用纸币和硬币）
